name: Apify
one_liner: Platform for running web scraping and automation Actors, with REST API, client libraries, and MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal API token from the Console, sent as a Bearer Authorization header (recommended) or as a token URL parameter. Scoped and expiring tokens are supported. OAuth applies to the hosted MCP server only.
access_notes: Free plan $0 with $5 prepaid usage, no credit card; paid Starter $19, Scale $199, Business $999. Free plan access blocked once prepaid usage is exhausted until next cycle.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free account and personal token, a documented REST API with an OpenAPI schema, and standard bearer auth. Per-Actor pricing and rate limits were not verified on the fetched pages.

access.quote: If you're on the free plan, your access to Apify's services will be blocked until the beginning of the next monthly cycle.

auth.quote: An Apify account with an API token.

api_surface.quote: Endpoints to manage Actors, runs, builds, tasks, datasets, key-value stores, request queues, schedules, webhooks, and your account.

sdks.quote: The official JavaScript library to access the Apify API
